strategyReview: Live performance is still being carried by the weekend funding-reversion complex (345/497 live wins, 69%; +$1.49 net) and the live one-touch NO edge (4/4 wins), while manual IV-touch rich NO shadows remain excellent (9/10). The bleeding is concentrated in PM proxy-short shadows, LLM/macro/PM-EV signals, and in shadow-mined variants that trigger on stale or non-extreme funding or grade contract-edge trades on spot moves; the portfolio is roughly flat/open with small unrealized losses and should not broaden until these clusters are re-authored or killed.

failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 3/21 shadows with -2.88% avg PnL; PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 1/16 with -6.12%; recent BTC proxy short lost -5.88% while sourceComparison showed opposite_direction and the source itself gained +1.01%.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not promote proxy-short variants; stop authoring new proxy-short hypotheses until source/proxy direction is positively correlated in the same signal, and let existing shadows expire.

failureClusters.theme: Weekend funding reversion triggered outside true extremes
failureClusters.evidence: CBRS H-539 is 12/26 scorable (46%), AAPL H-537 10/19 (53%), MU H-535 5/15 (33%). Outcomes often show funding already at 5.5% or moving flat from modest levels rather than normalizing from a deep weekend dislocation.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require true weekend day_of_week and regime-relative funding extremity (bottom decile/percentile) instead of a fixed -10% threshold on any day.

failureClusters.theme: BTC momentum/confirmation chases at local highs
failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 9/25 (36%) and btc_listed_iv_momentum_confirmation is 4/13 (31%). BTC near its 7d high plus HYPE risk-on or rising options IV often stalled or reversed rather than delivering >2% follow-through.
failureClusters.recommendation: Kill or re-author these chases: enter on pullbacks or relative strength, not after confirmation near the local top.

failureClusters.theme: Contract premium edges graded as spot direction
failureClusters.evidence: shadow_one_touch_high_edge_no_gold_heatmap H-534 is 2/14 scorable (14%) and burned 3 unscorable tests; results were evaluated on a >2% GOLD spot decline instead of contract PnL on the rich NO/YES premium.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author as a contract PnL thesis and drop the spot-move prediction, or retire the family as unscorable.

failureClusters.theme: Weak LLM/macro families remain live bleeders
failureClusters.evidence: LLM_HYPOTHESIS OIL live is 1/6 (17%) and -$0.39; MACRO_MOMENTUM_DOWN is 0/2; PM_EV_BELOW is 1/4. LLM_HYPOTHESIS overall average PnL is -0.89% per trade.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep LLM and macro signals disabled or very low weight, avoid OIL LLM entries, and do not promote PM_EV_BELOW above spot until clean evidence turns positive.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement: restrict CBRS funding reversion to true weekends and require the funding rate to be in the bottom percentile of its own 7d range, rather than using a fixed -10% threshold that fires after normalization has already occurred.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot/perp will gain >2% within 2 days as deeply negative weekend funding normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement: restrict AAPL funding reversion to weekends and use a regime-relative funding percentile instead of the fixed -10% threshold, avoiding the many triggers where funding was already positive or barely dislocated.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL spot/perp will gain >2% within 2 days as weekend funding dislocation normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement: restrict MU funding reversion to true weekend hours and require funding in the bottom percentile of its 7d range. The original -10% condition fired on flat or positive funding readings and gave no normalization edge.
newHypotheses.prediction: MU spot/perp will gain >2% within 2 days as deeply negative weekend funding normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement: re-author GOLD one-touch rich-NO as a contract premium fade instead of a spot-decline prediction. Grade on selling YES / holding NO when the GOLD above-strike underlying-cap edge is at least 10pts and spreads are tight.
newHypotheses.prediction: The NO side of GOLD above-strike one-touch contracts appreciates as rich sell-YES premium decays; contract PnL is positive without requiring any spot move.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement: change the BTC/HYPE confirmation from near-high chase to pullback reset. Require BTC below its 24h SMA and at least 4% off the 7d high while HYPE remains above its 24h SMA with stable OI, so HYPE strength is relative leadership rather than late-stage risk-on echo.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot/perp will gain >2% within 3 days after the pullback while HYPE retains risk-on strength.

newHypotheses.description: Fade BTC one-touch YES premium on above-strike contracts with moderate 3-8pt sell-YES edge and tight quoted spread.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / holding NO on BTC above-strike one-touch contracts will be profitable as the 3-8pt edge decays; contract PnL is positive rather than requiring a BTC spot move.

newHypotheses.description: Near-expiry refinement of the BTC one-touch NO edge: same 3-8pt moderate sell-YES edge and tight spread, but only on contracts expiring within 7 days.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / holding NO on near-expiry BTC above-strike one-touch contracts profits as premium decays into expiry; contract PnL is positive without requiring a BTC spot move.

newHypotheses.description: PM-IV rich one-touch NO fade: on above-strike contracts where Polymarket IV is at least 10 vol points above listed-option IV and the sell-YES edge is moderate (3-8pts), sell YES / hold NO with a tight spread gate.
newHypotheses.prediction: The NO side of rich-IV above-strike one-touch contracts appreciates as overpriced YES premium decays; contract PnL is positive rather than requiring a spot move.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The 12/26 scorable tests show the condition cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10 fires after funding has already normalized or while it is oscillating, for example 2.3% to 1.3% and -4.3% to -33.8%, so the expected snap-back is not present. It is a noisy threshold on a mean-reverting series, not a stable deep-dislocation signal.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within 2 days and forces a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL threshold < -10 triggers at readings that are already positive or modest, including 10.4% and 11.2%, and the measured move is often just back to a central 5.5% value. Only true deep weekend dislocations reverted with any consistency.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day rapidly normalizes and leads to a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: MU < -10 degrades because most triggers occur outside true weekend dislocations and funding is often already at or above 5.5%; the evaluated moves are flat or mildly lower instead of a strong reversion from an extreme.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Extreme negative MU funding (< -10%) outside true weekend hours reliably normalizes and yields >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The 2/14 scorable tests evaluate whether GOLD spot declines >2%, but the signal is a rich NO/YES premium on one-touch contracts. The trade is not a spot-decline bet; the contract itself may still deflate while spot does not move enough. Three additional tests were burned unscorable because the variant cannot be scored as written.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 9/25 scorable tests and multiple losses such as BTC -3.47% after trigger show near-high BTC plus HYPE above SMA and stable OI is not an independent continuation signal. HYPE strength is coincident with late-stage risk-on rallies rather than evidence of durable BTC upside.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE risk-on participation confirms durable BTC momentum rather than marking late-stage FOMO/overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 4/13 scorable tests show rising option IV after BTC spot is already strong does not produce reliable >2% follow-through; many observations stall or reverse. The IV rise is a coincident volatility repricing near highs, not a forward momentum confirmation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Spot momentum confirmed by rising options IV reliably leads to further >2% BTC gains within 3-7 days.

journalEntry: Tonight I focused on the six struggling families. The largest structural fix is re-authoring H-534 and similar contract-edge signals to be graded on contract PnL rather than a >2% spot move. Weekend funding variants need true weekend gates plus regime-relative funding percentile, not fixed -10% thresholds. The cross-asset and listed-IV BTC long variants are late-stage chasers at 7d highs; I set invalidated assumptions and proposed pullback/reset refinements. PM proxy-short shadows remain toxic and should not be promoted. No parameter updates were made because the current risk table is not clearly contradicted by the clean evidence.
